llm_analysis.reasoning: The computer vision half of this role (detection, tracking, segmentation, depth, embedded inference, defect inspection) is backed concretely across several projects and is above the bar. The equipment-control software engineering half (C# on Windows, UML specs, SQA, containers, databases) has almost no backing, and the 4-year C#/C++ requirement is the likely screen-out. Worth an application if the CV work is what the team is actually hiring for.
